tagline: Three lawns by the river, eighty members, open six days a week
about:
We've been playing on the three lawns at Riverside Park since 1967. Around eighty members, all welcome — competitive players, social players, and absolute beginners.

We play Association, Golf, and Ricochet. Equipment supplied. The clubhouse opens an hour before play for a cuppa and a chat.
play_schedule:
Monday 1pm — Association Croquet
Wednesday 9am — Golf Croquet
Friday 1pm — Ricochet
Saturday 2pm — Social play (all codes)

Summer hours apply Oct–Apr (start 30 minutes earlier).
come_and_try:
First Tuesday of every month, 10am. Free. Equipment provided.

Wear flat shoes and bring a hat. We'll teach you the basics in about 90 minutes.
fees:
Visitor green fee: $5
First Come & Try: free
Full membership: $140 / year (concession $90)
Coaching: free for members, $20 / session for non-members
address:
12 Riverside Drive, Riverbank QLD 4560
(Parking available on Park Road, behind the bowls club)
